body.purpose: Positive Tk font sizes are points, not pixels.

recents-body.purpose: Negative Tk font sizes are pixels multiplied by system DPI scale.

platform.runtime: Windows Python Tk/ttk; clam theme; custom Canvas popup
platform.popupScaling: System DPI divided by 96; base pixel dimensions are multiplied by this scale.
platform.popupShape: Smooth Canvas polygons and Windows transparent-color keying
platform.focus: Native controls use ttk behavior; the status indicator is nonactivating and click-through.
platform.componentPreview: Omitted: HTML/CSS would not reproduce native Tk and Windows behavior.
platform.reviewScope: Visual and usability review of the neutral restyle only; no full accessibility, recognition accuracy or universal application compatibility certification.

extensions.contrastException: White labels on solid gold retain the approved brand exception. This pairing does not establish ordinary small-text contrast compliance.
extensions.documentationEvidence: Refreshed against the implemented gold theme source and approved native gold previews. This is documentation of the approved palette and retained behavior, not accessibility certification.

narrative.overview: Light native settings and a dark recovery popup share neutral grays and SRC gold actions with Dictate and Snip. Native geometry, behavior and the shushing icon remain.
keyCharacteristics: Light settings and dark recovery popup
Gray selections and neutral status strip
dos: Preserve full phrase copying when display text is truncated.
Keep the settings controls accessible at both reviewed window sizes.
Keep the camera preview in its separate window.
Preserve the nonactivating, click-through status strip.
donts: Do not substitute web control previews for native behavior.
Do not claim unverified accessibility or scaling coverage.
